alerts.text: Changes since the 19:06 update: you made all four R12 trades (Robinson, Diop, Herrera, coach Masiulis (ZAL)). There are none left this round, so this report is about the lineup now and the R13 trades next. New news: Milutinov is out for Olympiacos at Maccabi with a finger fracture (back around 24 Nov). Bruno Fernando (Efes) is out 3–4 weeks with a calf injury. Booker (Milan) is confirmed out about 3 months, and Milan are signing Onyema.
Fix the app lineup: Herrera is still your 6th man. Use 3-1-1: Robinson, Nunn, Feliz / Vezenkov (C) / Diarra, with Malcolm as 6th man.

R13 plan (4 new trades, after Wednesday's games and before Thursday's tip-off): Nunn → Cameron Payne (IST), coach Masiulis (ZAL) → Albert (PAM), Davidovac → Tyson Ward (OLY), Feliz → Jordan Loyd (IST). R13 chance of 200: about 5.3% (vs 1.8% with no trades), with 0.5 left in the bank on site prices. Why: Nunn plays at Zalgiris on a back-to-back, against your own coach. Valencia host a weak Virtus (86% favourites). Efes host ASVEL (75%), so three Efes players boom together. Re-check after R12: prices change and the app's numbers are about 0.1–0.4 higher on each of your sells.

Your bank is 0.1 (you confirmed it in the app). The site still shows pre-R11 prices, so the squad value here (103.0 + coach) is below the app's 105.4. The total budget of 105.5 is from your screenshot.
No bookmaker key. Zalgiris–Bayern odds for Tuesday aren't posted yet; the March meeting in Kaunas was −400 (about 80%), which matches the site's 79%. The coach pick stands.
Unlimited trades from 21 Nov before R14. See the rebuild plan below, and don't pay for anything beyond R13 now.

rumours.text: Milan are signing center Ze'Rik Onyema from Scafati (buy-out). The announcement is expected early next week. Booker is out about 3 months (right rectus femoris tendon rupture).
rumours.impact: Diop keeps the big-man minutes in R12 (vs Zvezda) and probably R13. Onyema threatens his role from about R14, so Diop is a sell in the unlimited window.

rumours.text: Milutinov fractured the tip of his right index finger and misses Aris (Sunday) and Maccabi (Tuesday), with a return expected around 24 Nov. Montero is out long-term, and Dorsey isn't expected back for these games.
rumours.impact: Good for Vezenkov's minutes and touches at Maccabi, and helps Fall and Jones. It's also a reason Tyson Ward has a bigger role on Thursday vs Madrid.

rumours.text: Bruno Fernando is out 3–4 weeks with a calf injury (team doctor, after an MRI), expected back around 10 Dec. Papagiannis is back to cover.
rumours.impact: Malcolm and the guards (Payne, Loyd) get more usage. Efes are thinner in R12 at Dubai but heavy favourites at home to ASVEL in R13.

rumours.text: Nunn missed the 8 Nov league game at AEK because he travelled to Qatar for a passport (naturalisation). He's back for the EuroLeague.
rumours.impact: It doesn't affect R12, but it explains his missing domestic minutes. PAN may manage him on the R12–R13 back-to-back (at Virtus, then at Zalgiris).

review: Scorecard: no newly finished round to grade yet. R12 starts Tuesday, and the predictions saved with this report grade it then. R11 (unofficial, our count) was about 168 with your screenshot lineup: Vezenkov (C) 57, Faye 21, Feliz 19, and coach Penarroya (PAR) +20, while Madar 11, Joksimović 2 and Davidovac 8 held it back. Calls: selling Madar was right (broken nose, still doubtful), and the coach switch to Masiulis (ZAL) still looks right: Valančiūnas was R11 MVP and Zalgiris are about 80% to beat Bayern. Owned miss: earlier today the report didn't flag that R12's trades were already used, and my_team.json still showed 4 trades left. That's fixed (set to 0), and this run plans R13's trades instead. Research: 23 searches, 4 pages read, 1 player unverified (Diop domestic).
window_plan: I'd make rebuild 1 with one change. Sell Nunn, Herrera, Davidovac, Joksimović and Diarra; buy Payne, Frisch, Procida, Valančiūnas and Llull, with coach Martinez (MAD). Valančiūnas is the clear upgrade at center, and Procida and Frisch are minutes-backed cheap enablers. I'd check Llull against Madrid's guard returns (Campazzo, Maledon) before the window, and keep Diop only until Onyema is registered. The R13 trades above already move Nunn → Payne, so the window needs fewer moves. Prices will shift after R12–R13, so I'll redo this on 21 Nov.
